coreIdea: Pointer = holds an address. * = dereference (get value there). p+k = k elements ahead (type-scaled). Array name decays to pointer: a[i]≡*(a+i).
mustRememberFormulas: q-p = element count difference, not byte difference
int *A[10] = array of pointers; int (*A)[10] = pointer to array (parentheses matter)

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: pointer arithmetic / array-of-pointers code, asked for output
function returns a pointer, or pointer used before init
confusing declaration with * and [] and () mixed
function takes a pointer param, modifies caller's variable

commonTrapsQuickList: Pointer arithmetic is TYPE-scaled, not raw bytes
Returning address of a LOCAL variable = dangling pointer (undefined behavior)
malloc'd memory is safe to return a pointer to; stack-local is not
Read declarations right-to-left around parentheses, not left-to-right
highYieldPyqLessons: Arithmetic-tracing (6/15) needs an actual memory diagram every time — never do it purely in your head.
2022 onward this topic tests multi-step pointer reassignment chains — practice tracing 4-5 sequential pointer operations, not just single-step ones.
